function: DRL allocates per-slot resources for UAV-assisted digital-twin synchronization
note: The DRL solves per-slot resource allocation for digital-twin synchronization in UAV-assisted edge computing, and the abstract does not say whether its actions include UAV link power or bandwidth (physical layer under the NTN exception) or only edge computing and semantic extraction decisions.

function: RL places security-aware service function chains in UAV ad hoc networks
note: Reinforcement learning decides service function chain placement in flying ad hoc networks, which is network virtualization and management above the physical layer.

function: Classifies indoor LOS/NLOS signals from phase histograms, without learning
note: The LOS/NLOS identifier relies on phase histograms of modulated signals and is stated to be free of machine learning models, and its purpose, indoor positioning, is also an excluded function.

function: MARL schedules cooperative radar search beams and tasks for multiple UAVs
note: The learned policy schedules airborne radar search beams and search tasks in a radar-only system that does not communicate, which is sensing alone.

function: Federated learning predicts traffic for satellite constellation resource pre-allocation
note: The learned component is federated traffic prediction that feeds routing and per-node resource pre-allocation in a satellite constellation, which is traffic management above the physical layer.

function: MLP surrogate predicts RIS element reflection for unit-cell design optimization
note: Machine learning serves as an electromagnetic surrogate to design and fabricate RIS unit-cell hardware rather than to configure RIS phase shifts, which is metasurface hardware design.

function: Chance-constrained MU-MIMO beamforming from limited CSI samples, without learning
note: The beamformer comes from chance-constrained programming with a Wasserstein ambiguity set built from CSI samples, solved by binary search and convex approximation, with no model trained on data.

function: CNN-LSTM selects modulation and coding for AFDM ISAC UAV links
note: The only learned part is a CNN-LSTM that chooses the modulation and coding scheme from sensing parameters and CSI, which is link adaptation, while the sensing and the AFDM prefix design are not learned.

function: QAOA quantum optimization of b-bit quantized MIMO beamforming
note: QAOA with alternating optimization is a quantum combinatorial optimizer run per problem instance, not a method trained on data or by interaction.

function: Regularized SBL algorithm estimates RIS cascaded channels with few pilots
note: Sparse Bayesian learning here is an EM-based iterative sparse-recovery algorithm run on each pilot observation, with no model trained on data.

function: GAT-based DRL selects paths and allocates resources to network slices
note: The DRL performs end-to-end path selection and network resource assignment for slices, which is network slicing above the physical layer rather than satellite link power, subchannel, or beam control.

function: Communication-aware optimizer for global FedMeta model updates over UAV links
note: The paper designs the global model update of federated meta-learning under update losses over UAV links, with no over-the-air computation described, so it falls outside area 7.

function: Distilled RF-fingerprint LLM identifies individual UAVs
note: The learned model identifies individual UAVs from RF fingerprints, which is emitter identification and RF fingerprinting, an excluded function.

function: Derives optimal Zak-OTFS receivers via twisted convolution matched filtering
note: The paper derives and analyzes optimal Zak-OTFS receiver implementations analytically, without any learned component.

function: Optimizes uplink power for FL in cell-free massive MIMO
note: Uplink power allocation is solved with Brent's method, coordinate gradient descent, bisection, and SQP, and federated learning is only the application the uplink serves, with no over-the-air aggregation described.

function: Reviews deep learning channel estimation and detection for multi-antenna systems
note: The paper is a comprehensive review of deep learning channel estimation and symbol detection for massive MIMO and RIS systems, not a new method.

function: Non-learning discrete diffusion sampling detector for massive MIMO
note: The diffusion-based detector is stated to be an analytical, non-learning sampling process, so no component is trained.

function: Multi-objective RL optimizes UAV trajectory in wireless-charged MEC
note: Multi-objective reinforcement learning only optimizes the UAV flight trajectory, which is above the physical layer, with no learned power, resource, or beam control.

function: MARL schedules data partitioning, resources, and aggregation transmission for satellite FL
note: MARL jointly decides data partitioning, resource allocation, and aggregation transmission for FL in satellite edge computing, and the abstract does not say whether the learned allocation and transmission actions include satellite link power or bandwidth (NTN) or only computing and routing.

function: Optimizes IRS phases, scheduling, and resources for FL uploads without learning
note: Device scheduling, IRS phase shifts, and resources are optimized by a structure-based optimal algorithm and SCA, and federated learning with TDMA, FDMA, or NOMA uploads is only the application the link serves.

function: Iterative search allocates bandwidth and UAV rates for distilled hierarchical FL
note: Bandwidth and UAV rate allocation uses a non-learned iterative search, while the learning is a hierarchical FL scheme with dataset distillation that performs no physical-layer function.

function: DNN predicts outage and sum rate of UAV STAR-RIS RSMA network
note: The DNN only predicts outage probability and ergodic sum rate of an analyzed UAV STAR-RIS RSMA network and does not configure the RIS or perform any of the seven functions.

function: MADRL trains semantic transmission, reconstruction, and control-gain modules for robot control
note: The learned modules decide when to transmit semantic control information, reconstruct it, and set control gains for a wireless control loop, which is semantic communication without any of the seven functions.

function: SCA and greedy resource scheduling for federated distillation over UAV links
note: Cross-layer resource scheduling is solved by SCA and a greedy algorithm, and the federated distillation it serves exchanges average logits with no over-the-air computation described.

function: RL decides RIS deployment locations for sensing and communication coverage
note: Reinforcement learning chooses where to deploy RISs, a network planning decision like node placement, rather than RIS phase shifts, and its sensing objective is localization coverage.

function: SDR/SCA design of MIMO AirComp transceivers for edge inference
note: The MIMO AirComp precoder and receive beamformer are designed by SDR and SCA to carry device-edge inference, so learning is only the served application and no model is trained over the air.
